activation: Report emitted non-null, accepted non-null and rejected reconstructions separately over all actual normal generations; no numeric near-every-turn threshold invented after outcomes.
quality_sample: Every accepted non-null reconstruction; no deduplication hides per-request churn. Judge action relevance and label-like content manually against actual delivered evidence.
grounding: Among reconstructions declaring critical parameters, report declared supports_value coverage and separately whether exact delivered body supports those values.
freshness: Dynamic block must contain only actually included SUPERSEDED/DELETED materials. Report current ref and actual current-body delivery separately; no semantic verdict.
current_evidence: Report actual exact current memory use, stale supports_value attempts/rejections, contextual historical use, and UNKNOWN rather than guessing.
unresolved: With insufficient delivered evidence, report action-sensitive gap vs invented parameters; do not equate a nonempty gap string to sufficient handling.
null_business: ACTION_WITHOUT_RECONSTRUCTION records ordinary legal execution; no compulsory reconstruction gate.
token_measurement: Pinned tokenizer on exact delivered fragments and original response field text. Fragments are included in total usage, not additive billing; truncated output remains fully charged.

ablation.equivalent_or_better: F-only completes the same real old/current acquisition, freshness and approved action requirements without new auxiliary harm; do not credit deleted reconstruction criteria as an ODR advantage.
ablation.if_freshness_only_sufficient: Select simpler freshness-only active method; keep frozen ODR evidence for reproduction, do not claim reconstruction increment.

conditional_gates.V5: All three ODR mechanism cases pass
conditional_gates.V6: All three mechanism cases pass and structured ODR is not stopped by section44; if F-only wins, record selected simpler method explicitly
conditional_gates.V7: V6 no obvious degradation; compare current completion/semantic evidence without treating historical scores as a matched causal estimate

stopping: Apply plan section44: unstable initial acquisition, structured burden, stale support, separate model call, forced search, activation near every request, or equally effective simpler freshness-only. Complete required implementation/evidence/report even for negative research outcomes.
historical_comparisons: v16 7/12 and v17 5/12 are descriptive development history only; v18 early failures are not completed-task cost baselines.
